### The Generations of Shem
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/generations-shem
Passage: Genesis 11:10-26
Points:
- Moses places Shem’s genealogy right after Babel to prepare readers for redemptive history.
- The genealogy selectively focuses on Abram’s direct ancestors, highlighting divine election.
- God's providential choice of an ancestral line does not mean every individual possesses personal saving faith.
- Even when false religion spreads, God remains faithful to preserve a remnant who loves the truth.
- Believers can trust God to sustain His church and are urged to support the teaching of God's Word.
